_comment: ecodex L3 curated model seed. LEAN entries — only the curated/epistemic fields live here; codex-runtime fields (base_instructions, shell_type, truncation_policy, ...) are inherited from build_fallback_model_info at merge time (see models-manager/src/lib.rs). Exact-slug entries here take precedence over the recognize_open_weights_family prefix table. Slugs churn monthly — re-verify against provider/OpenRouter pages and bump last_verified. calibration_tier is ALWAYS 'unmeasured' on seed: it is populated by our own grounded usage trajectories, never asserted upfront.

seed.description: OpenRouter's auto-router: sends each request to whichever frontier model wins for the prompt. NOT a fixed model — context window is variable per-routed request. Conservative 200K default avoids over-stuffing when it routes to a smaller-window model.
